_doc: Per-person lines read by an outcome's 'people_lines' field (ENCOUNTER_STORIES_DRAFT C18, The Gate, floors 94-98). For each person in the table, the FIRST line whose condition holds is a candidate. A line holds when every key given holds: 'status' (str or list) and 'deserving' (true/false) against deeds['people'][person], and 'when' (a deeds condition, DEEDS 4.3). A person never recorded in deeds['people'] still counts if 'when' holds. Candidates are ordered with the fates first (a line whose status or 'when' names lost, spared or saved), then the most recent first; at most 'max' are told. Never a verdict on the hero; changes nothing mechanical; never touches the floor 99 Judgment. Person ids must match the encounters' 'person.id' and deed ids.

lines.name: Marta Venn
lines.line: Marta Venn. Walked out on that leg. Ratted till she was seventy and never stopped talking about you.

lines.name: Marta Venn
lines.line: Marta Venn. The leg held, as it happens, mostly. Her girl does the climbing now.

lines.name: Marta Venn
lines.line: Marta Venn. Got home without her satchel. Three children on the ward didn't. She never said your name. Lena did.

lines.name: Ysolde
lines.line: Ysolde and her girl. Benno's fever broke on the eighth night. They named the goat after you. It's a nice goat.

lines.name: Dafydd
lines.line: Dafydd. Lived to be sixty and told the story of Sergeant Ilse every winter. He told it right.

lines.name: Ilse Marr
lines.line: Ilse Marr. Went home to her husband and his terrible cheese. She kept Dafydd's name in her prayers.

lines.name: Father Anselm
lines.line: Father Anselm. Back in his parish. Prays for you on Thursdays. He picked Thursdays.

lines.name: Morrow
lines.line: Morrow. You let him out. He used it badly. He isn't coming through this gate, and he knows why.

lines.name: Konstantin Volkov
lines.line: Konstantin Volkov. Held the door. Came through here standing up. Asked after his farmers first.

lines.name: Jory Pell
lines.line: Jory Pell. They stopped calling him Trembler. He made sergeant.

lines.name: Theodoros of Nicaea
lines.line: Theodoros of Nicaea. Taught six languages to anybody who asked, free. Said a stranger once overpaid for him.

lines.name: Sariel
lines.line: Sariel asked me to tell you she hasn't forgotten. She doesn't, you know. Angels.

lines.name: Tansy
lines.line: Tansy. Flies again. Hates jars. Will not discuss it.

lines.name: Lucan Dray
lines.line: Lucan Dray. Ran a fifth time, and a sixth. We'll talk, him and me. It will be a long talk.

lines.name: Lucan Dray
lines.line: Lucan Dray. Stood his trial and served his years and swept the church at Dunmore after. Aurel never forgave him. That's allowed.

lines.name: Silas Mordaunt
lines.line: Silas Mordaunt. Three more names before the fever took him. That's on him. A little of it's on the lock.

lines.name: Ostrander
lines.line: Ostrander. Kept his lamp lit forty years. People who never knew his name got home by it.

lines.name: Ostrander
lines.line: Ostrander. Went back to his old trade. The sea's got him now, and the sea is not a forgiving employer.

lines.name: Oswin of Harrow
lines.line: Oswin of Harrow. Took his sentence without a word. Thale's children put flowers on his grave. I'd call that settled.

lines.name: Oswin of Harrow
lines.line: Oswin of Harrow. Seven hundred and some, by my count, before they stopped him. He came through still apologising.

lines.name: Tobyn
lines.line: Tobyn. Knighted at nineteen. Carries Brennan's sword, and tells his own squire he's ready far too early.

lines.name: Celeste Arrowmere
lines.line: Celeste Arrowmere. Buried Maren properly. Comes down every spring to sit with her.

lines.name: Hal Mercer
lines.line: Hal Mercer and Edwin Corley. Came through together. Hal went first this time.

lines.name: Corwen Ashby
lines.line: Corwen Ashby. Back in his schoolroom. Taught the first letters to forty more children and never once mentioned the book.

lines.name: Davy Hollins
lines.line: Davy Hollins. Limped for a year. Made foreman. First thing he did was pull out the north props himself.

lines.name: Wat Rowe
lines.line: Wat Rowe. Lit his six for another two winters. Asked after the stranger who did the seventh, every time.

lines.name: Ahwere
lines.line: Ahwere asked me to tell you: no one had ever left it before. She said it twice, so I would get it right.

lines.name: Roland
lines.line: Roland. Came through still arguing with Oliver. Oliver let him, this once.

lines.name: Neferkaptah
lines.line: Neferkaptah. Still waiting for his book. He'll wait. He's good at it.
